title: TDMA: wire DesyncFSM into the beacon RX path with epoch-floor validation (Zephyr integration)
description: Deferred half of b7z9.12.2. The DesyncFSM core (eda353bf65) and its vector consumption (3f6ca8883b) are host-side; the FSM inputs are not yet driven by real signals. Wire in the Zephyr beacon RX path (lichen_link_rx.c / wherever valid beacons are authenticated): on SFN wrap call lichen_desync_on_sfn_wrap(time_valid = lichen_wall_clock_valid()); on each authenticated beacon call lichen_desync_on_beacon(valid = lichen_epoch_floor_accepts(beacon ts) && SFN match) per time_sync.c:571; drive lichen_desync_on_missed_superframe from the superframe tick. Also sync tdma->synced with the FSM reaching SYNCED if the CCP integration requires it. Vectors already exist (packets-timing.json desync_fsm_* — consumed host-side; ccp16-desync.json recovery entries). Requires hardware-independent validation via native_sim build of a TDMA-enabled target. Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.12.2.
